gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed WHO Grade 4 astrocytoma from archival tissue. IDH mutation status and MGMT promoter methylation status will not limit candidacy but needs to be known.

candidate_evidence.quote: FT536 is an allogeneic natural killer (NK)-cell immunotherapy produced from a clonal master human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) line

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Evidence of first or second cancer recurrence/ progression by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)

role_evidence.quote: FT536 is an allogeneic natural killer (NK)-cell immunotherapy produced from a clonal master human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) line

agents.drug_class_hint: FT536: allogeneic iPSC-derived MICA/B CAR NK-cell therapy (CD38 knockout, hnCD16, IL-15/IL-15Ra fusion), given intratumorally

coder_notes: Glioblastoma named in conditions; eligibility is WHO grade 4 astrocytoma irrespective of IDH status (IDH-mutant allowed), so coded gbm_only with historical terminology. Only intervention is an NK-cell therapy (excluded type), so S6 fails. IDH and MGMT status must be known but do not restrict entry; listed as exploratory_correlative (no better role available). Tumour/CSF sampling planned for FT536 persistence and microenvironment effects, but FT536 is not a candidate, so PK/target engagement coded no. Three dose-level arms, none a control. Dexamethasone and MRI contrast mentioned only in eligibility, not listed.
